user.title: Configure Zyxel Device
user.description: Configure your Zyxel NWA50AX access point

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Zyxel Device
reconfigure.description: Update the connection details without removing and re-adding the integration.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The AP rejected the stored credentials. Enter the current SSH password.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to device. Check IP address and network.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check username and password.

intervals.title: Refresh intervals
intervals.description: How often each group is refreshed. Which data belongs to which group is set separately, in "Data assignment".

data_groups.title: Data assignment
data_groups.description: Choose which refresh group (Fast / Slow / Daily) each family of data belongs to. Defaults match the recommended split; change any of them freely.

display.title: Display
display.description: Choose how the SSID switches are named. When enabled, each switch shows the real WiFi name your devices see (e.g. "SSID MyHome Schedule") instead of the internal AP profile name (e.g. "SSID Home Schedule"). This applies to every SSID switch, Guest included. The profile name is always available in the switch attributes.

data.use_real_ssid_names: Use the real SSID in switch names

invert.title: Invert switches
invert.description: Choose which SSID switches are reversed. Normal switch: ON = the schedule is active (the SSID follows its planned hours), OFF = SSID always on. Reversed switch: ON = SSID always on (schedule disabled), OFF = the schedule is active. A reversed switch shows "[reversed]" in its name. By default only Guest is reversed (its historical behaviour). Unselect everything to have no reversed switch.

write.title: Save config button
write.description: Choose how the Save config (write) button asks for confirmation. Unchecked (default): two presses - the first press shows in a notification what would be made permanent, the second press within 60 s saves. Checked: a single press saves immediately, and the notification then lists what was made permanent. Only check it if you put a confirmation dialog on your dashboard button (see the README): once checked, ANY press - automation, voice assistant, another dashboard - saves right away.

mikrotik.title: MikroTik hostname resolver
mikrotik.description: Optional. Resolves device hostnames from MikroTik DHCP leases - fully decoupled from the Zyxel AP connection (its own connection, its own cycle, its own cache).

security.title: Security - SSH fingerprints
security.description: SSH host key fingerprints are remembered on first connection (Trust On First Use) and checked on every connection afterwards. Current Zyxel fingerprint: {zyxel_fingerprint}. Current MikroTik fingerprint: {mikrotik_fingerprint}. Only reset a fingerprint if you know the key change is legitimate (device replaced/factory reset) - otherwise it could indicate someone intercepting the connection.

abort.not_ready: The integration has not read the AP's SSIDs yet (it is still loading, or the AP is unreachable). Wait a minute, then open this screen again.
